label: ILLUSTRATIVE_FIXTURE
honesty: Fixture rows and fields are NOT the learner's device measurements. Crafted Ethernet/IPv4 teaching story with WAIKE lab_datapath competency adjacency (not a WAIKE validator submission).
documentation_addresses_note: IPv4 addresses use RFC 5737 documentation ranges (192.0.2.0/24, 203.0.113.0/24).

ethernet.scope_hint: LAN / link layer on an access network — not 'the Internet' by itself

ipv4.scope_hint: Network-layer forwarding toward a remote service

scopes.device: Local app initiates the sync/send action
scopes.lan: On-link Ethernet/Wi-Fi segment and typically a gateway/NAT
scopes.internet: Routed path beyond the local network boundary
scopes.dns: Name resolution dependency that may precede connect (separate failure mode)
scopes.service: Destination application endpoint the user thinks of as 'the app'

access_network.note: Wi-Fi is an access network. Cellular is a different access network. Neither synonym equals Internet or cloud.

placement_hypothesis.evidence_needed: RTT/region hints, CDN or provider documentation — not signal bars alone

parse_questions.ask: What is the IPv4 TTL in this fixture?
Is Wi-Fi the same thing as the Internet in this lab's teaching model?
Is 'cloud-far' marked as observation or inference in this fixture?
